## Goal

Every D26 library is one import away, themed by the tokens, and the live chart stays smooth at high rates.

## Owned requirements

Close each with the check below, through the real public interface (README §3).

## Scope

From [WORK_PACKAGES.md](../WORK_PACKAGES.md):

- token-aware wrappers: Recharts 3 through shadcn charts, a uPlot live chart with append-mode `useLive`, ECharts 6, TanStack Table 9, Mermaid 12, `@xyflow/react` 12, Excalidraw, MapLibre with deck.gl, react-three-fiber, Shiki and CodeMirror 6, KaTeX;
- the warm set and on-demand set as D65 defines them;
- license and version re-verification recorded in VERIFIED_FACTS.

Design detail for this package:

- Token-aware wrappers per library; warm set versus on-demand per D65.
- uPlot live chart on `useLive` append mode; set and measure the target rate (at least 60 updates per second with 10k points on CI hardware).
- License and version re-verification recorded in VERIFIED_FACTS.

## Out of scope

- Motion and decks (WP-21)

## Acceptance evidence

a render test per library in three browsers; the uPlot path holds the target rate (target set in the WP spec from a measured baseline, at least 60 updates per second with 10k points on CI hardware) without frame drops beyond the budget; the license audit stays green.

Also: `pnpm check` green (from WP-01 on), diff reviewed, evidence matrix rows updated, docs and AGENTS.md current, progress report written after acceptance (README §4).
